description: Set character formatting on text: font, size, leading, kerning, tracking, scale, baseline shift, skew, rotation, case, position, ligatures, No Break, strikethrough, language, fill and stroke (Character panel, Advanced Character Formats); OpenType options; CJK options (ruby, kenten, warichu, shatai, tate-chu-yoko, mojikumi, kinsoku, aki, tsume, gyoudori); and Middle Eastern options (direction, digits, kashidas, diacritics). Only the attributes you pass change.

character.description: Character panel, Advanced Character Formats and Character Color options

capitalization.description: Case: NORMAL, ALL_CAPS, SMALL_CAPS, or CAP_TO_SMALL_CAP (OpenType All Small Caps)

designAxes.description: Variable font axis values, in the font's axis order (see manage_fonts list for axis names)

fillColor.description: Text fill colour: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

fontName.description: Font as "Family\tStyle" (e.g. "Minion Pro\tBold") or a family name; a composite font name also works

fontStyle.description: Font style within the family, e.g. "Bold Italic"

kerningMethod.description: Pair kerning: metrics, optical or none (manual)

kerningValue.description: Manual kerning in thousandths of an em (applies between characters; set at an insertion point or on a range)

language.description: Language for spelling and hyphenation, e.g. "English: USA" or "German: 2006 Reform"

ligatures.description: Standard ligatures (fi, fl; also Arabic and Hebrew ligature formation)

noBreak.description: No Break: keep the text on one line

position.description: Position: NORMAL, SUPERSCRIPT, SUBSCRIPT, or the OpenType OT_SUPERSCRIPT (superior), OT_SUBSCRIPT (inferior), OT_NUMERATOR, OT_DENOMINATOR

strokeColor.description: Text stroke colour: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em

cjk.description: CJK options: ruby, kenten, warichu, shatai, tate-chu-yoko, mojikumi, kinsoku, aki, tsume, gyoudori

autoTcy.description: Auto tate-chu-yoko: run this many half-width characters or fewer horizontally (0 off)

bunriKinshi.description: Bunri-kinshi: keep .., ... and -- from separating at a line break

characterAlignment.description: Alignment of small characters to the largest in the line

cjkGridTracking.description: Use grid tracking for CJK characters in frame grids

gridGyoudori.description: Gyoudori: number of grid lines a line occupies

jidori.description: Jidori: number of grid squares to arrange the text in

kentenCharacterSet.description: How the custom kenten character is given

kentenColor.description: Kenten colour: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

kentenKind.description: Kenten (emphasis mark) character; NONE removes kenten

kentenPlacement.description: Distance between kenten and the characters

kinsokuSet.description: Kinsoku set: a kinsoku table name, or HARD_KINSOKU, SOFT_KINSOKU, KOREAN_KINSOKU, SIMPLIFIED_CHINESE_KINSOKU, TRADITIONAL_CHINESE_KINSOKU or NOTHING

leadingAki.description: Aki before each character (-1 for automatic)

mojikumi.description: Mojikumi set: a mojikumi table name in the document, or a MojikumiTableDefaults name such as LINE_END_ALL_ONE_HALF_EM_ENUM; NOTHING turns it off

paragraphGyoudori.description: Apply gyoudori to the whole paragraph rather than each line

rensuuji.description: Rensuuji: no line breaks inside multi-digit numbers

rotateRoman.description: Rotate half-width Roman characters upright in vertical text

rubyAutoScaling.description: Scale ruby to rubyParentScalingPercent of the parent size

rubyColor.description: Ruby colour: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

rubyOverhang.description: How far ruby may overhang the parent text

rubyParentScalingPercent.description: Ruby size as a percent of the parent text size

rubyParentSpacing.description: Spacing of the parent text under ruby

rubyXOffset.description: Horizontal space between ruby and parent

rubyYOffset.description: Vertical space between ruby and parent

tateChuYoko.description: Tate-chu-yoko: set the characters horizontally in vertical text

trailingAki.description: Aki after each character (-1 for automatic)

tsume.description: Tsume: horizontal compression around the character, percent

warichu.description: Warichu: set the text as inline notes in several small lines

warichuCharsAfterBreak.description: Minimum warichu characters after a line break

warichuCharsBeforeBreak.description: Minimum warichu characters before a line break

warichuLineSpacing.description: Gap between warichu lines in points

warichuSize.description: Warichu size, percent of the parent text

opentype.description: Character panel menu > OpenType options (applied when the font has the feature)

glyphForm.description: Alternate glyph form substituted for the standard glyphs

localizedForms.description: Localized forms for the applied language

positionalForm.description: Positional forms: NONE (general), CALCULATE (automatic), INITIAL, MEDIAL, FINAL, ISOLATED

stylisticSets.description: Stylistic sets to turn on, numbers 1-20; [] turns them all off

text.description: Which text to act on. Give text frame ids, story ids, or selection: true; optionally narrow each to a character range (start/end) or a paragraph range (paragraphs)

end.description: Last character, inclusive (default: the end of the text)

ids.description: Text frame ids (PageItem.id); acts on the text in each frame, or its whole story with wholeStory

paragraphs.description: [first, last] paragraph indexes (0-based, inclusive) within each chosen text

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frames

start.description: First character (0-based, within each chosen text)

wholeStory.description: For frames and selected text, act on the whole story they belong to

worldReady.description: Middle Eastern and Indic options: direction, digits, kashidas, diacritics

kashidaWidth.description: Paragraph kashida width: 0 none, 1 short, 2 medium, 3 long

name: set_character_attributes
title: Set Character Attributes
